tables.name: gold_investment_report_holdings_weekly_by_currency
tables.purpose: Weekly holdings by currency, showing the latest market value for each holding within the week.
tables.sql:
create table gold_investment_report_holdings_weekly_by_currency as
with latest as (
  select
    instrument_id,
    portfolio_id,
    currency,
    value_amount,
    valuation_date,
    row_number() over (partition by instrument_id, portfolio_id, date_trunc('week', valuation_date) order by valuation_date desc) as rn
  from valuation_observations
)
select
  date_trunc('week', valuation_date) as week_end,
  currency,
  sum(value_amount) as total_market_value
from latest
where rn = 1
group by 1, 2
